name: study_diagnostics
description: Inspect the state of study mode: how many documents and pages, highlights, notes, spaced-repetition decks, total study time, and per-document progress. Use this to answer questions about the user's study activity or to orient before helping.

action.description: overview = whole-mode snapshot; library = all documents; notes = all notes; sessions = time-on-doc totals; document = one document's detail (needs doc_id).

doc_id.description: For action=document: the document to inspect. Omit to use the open document.
